system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: arranges the input. The list element order matters here and this applies to all the following list input/output specifications.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt assembled from configurable sections (objective, previous plans, interaction history, observation) plus per-action specification files; paper Fig. 3. Line numbers not available in bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: If `fullpage==True`, the agent takes the entire page as the input.
env_context_strategy.note: Web environment: current page observation (accessibility tree) is given each step; agent navigates via click/type/go_back.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Steps taken for earlier plans and their observations will be dismissed in the current plan's observation window
context_compaction.note: Pivotal-node selective replay prunes observations; interaction_history step_num: 3 limits history window; planning-tree scoping drops earlier-plan steps. Model also outputs 'interaction history summary'.

observation_format.evidence_quote: You can use `type: ["text", "image"]` to enable multimodality inputs.
observation_format.note: Default text (pruned accessibility tree/Markdown); images opt-in.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: capable LLMs should generate those content, which would be parsed automatically by the code.
tool_call_format.note: Actions are free-text command strings like click [id] parsed from labelled output sections; closest value chosen; parser file not in bundle.

tool_count.note: Default AgentOccam.yml: 5 navigation + 2 planning commands; go_home added for multisite tasks.

edit_primitive.note: Web agent; no file-editing actions in the action registry.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: You only need to add the description for that entry under `AgentOccam/prompts/output_specifications`.
tool_schema_source.note: Action specs are hand-written txt files under prompts/navigation_specifications.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file or source grep available in bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If you use best-of-**N**-actions with judge, the `number` here defines the **N**.
loop_primitives.note: Default single-actor react loop; best-of-N actions with judge config-reachable (AgentOccam-Judge.yml).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: We introduce two actions, branch and prune, to generate plans in a tree structure and save them for future observations.

multi_agent_topology.note: Critic and judge disabled by default; actor+judge reachable via config.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: For other roles, you can disable them by changing `mode` to false.
delegation_mechanism.note: SteP stack-based sub-policy spawning reachable via AgentOccam-SteP.yml (webagents_step/agents/step_agent.py).

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: When `debug==1`, it plays and you decide whether to take its action.
human_in_loop.note: Default debug: 0 (no gating); debug==2 human writes action.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The branch action will generate new subplans under the current node
short_term_state.note: Planning tree plus notes kept beyond message history.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: We achieve this without using in-context examples, new agent roles, online feedback or search strategies.
long_term_memory.note: Agent_E vendored static_ltm belongs to baseline replication.

self_verification.evidence_quote: These action candidates are then evaluated by another LLM ( GPT-4-turbo as well) prompted to play the role of a judge and select the best action.

retry_policy.note: Step-level parse retry (max_retry) not task retry.

termination_condition.note: stop action ends trajectory (paper Sec. 4.1); max_actions shown in SteP agent loop.

execution_isolation.note: Playwright browser locally; no deployment config shown.

tracing.evidence_quote: This determines where the trajectories will be saved.

replayability.note: TeacherForcingAgent replays reference action sequences (webarena/agent/agent.py) but is WebArena baseline code.

target_domain.evidence_quote: AgentOccam offers a simple but strong baseline for LLM-based web agents.

open_source.evidence_quote: Our code and data are available at https://github.com/amazon-science/AgentOccam.
open_source.note: LICENSE file present but content not in bundle.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Optional, we provide several other agent base models, such as Claude and LLaMa.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Code for "[AgentOccam: A Simple Yet Strong Baseline for LLM-Based Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13825)" (ICLR 2025).
primary_artifact.note: Repo code frozen close to paper.

first_release_date.note: No tag/first commit info; paper v1 date not in bundle.

stars.note: Date of star count not stated.
